tasks.title: Environment Configuration Validation
tasks.description: Implement validation for required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) with clear error messages when missing. Add validation function that runs before any API calls.
outputs: Clear error messages for missing credentials
acceptance_criteria: Script throws informative error if NOTION_API_KEY is missing
Script throws informative error if NOTION_DATABASE_ID is missing
Validation runs before any Notion API calls

tasks.title: Fix Task Assignment Implementation
tasks.description: Resolve discrepancy where createTask accepts assignedTo parameter but hardcodes empty array. Implement proper people field assignment in Notion API call. Research Notion API people field format requirements.
acceptance_criteria: assignedTo parameter is actually used in API call
Tasks can be assigned to Notion users
Parameter accepts valid Notion user ID format

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
tasks.description: Add getTask(pageId) and listTasks(filters) functions to query tasks from Notion database. Support filtering by status, assignee, and date ranges.
acceptance_criteria: Can retrieve single task by page ID
Can list all tasks from database

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Functionality
tasks.description: Add deleteTask(pageId) function to archive or delete tasks from Notion. Note: Notion API archives pages rather than deleting them permanently.
outputs: Proper handling of Notion archive operation
acceptance_criteria: Can archive task by page ID

tasks.title: Add Input Validation Layer
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive input validation for all functions. Validate title length, status values against allowed list, pageId format, and other parameters before making API calls.
outputs: Input sanitization for all public functions
Documented list of valid status values
acceptance_criteria: All functions validate inputs before API calls
Clear error messages for invalid inputs
Status values validated against allowed list

tasks.title: Implement Structured Logging System
tasks.description: Replace console.log/console.error with structured logging system. Support different log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR) and optional log file output.

tasks.title: Implement Batch Operations
tasks.description: Add functions for batch task creation and updates. Support creating multiple tasks in single call and updating multiple tasks with same status change.
acceptance_criteria: Can create multiple tasks in one operation
Can update multiple tasks in one operation

tasks.title: Add Task Search and Filtering
tasks.description: Implement advanced search and filtering capabilities. Support full-text search in task titles and notes, complex filter combinations, and sorting options.
acceptance_criteria: Can search tasks by text in title or notes
Can sort results by various fields
Can paginate through large result sets

tasks.title: Refactor Main Function for Library Usage
tasks.description: Remove auto-executing main() function and setTimeout anti-pattern. Make script importable as library while supporting CLI execution mode. Add proper async handling.
outputs: Conditional execution based on import vs direct run
acceptance_criteria: main() only runs when script executed directly
Can import functions without side effects

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Unit Tests
tasks.description: Write unit tests for all functions using Jest or Mocha. Mock Notion API calls. Test success cases, error cases, and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover success and error cases

tasks.title: Add Rate Limiting and Retry Logic
tasks.description: Implement rate limiting to respect Notion API limits (3 requests per second). Add exponential backoff retry logic for failed requests.
outputs: Configuration for max retries and delays

tasks.title: Create API Documentation
tasks.description: Write comprehensive API documentation including function signatures, parameters, return values, examples, and error handling. Document Notion database schema requirements.

tasks.title: Add CLI Interface
tasks.description: Create command-line interface for common operations (create, update, list, delete tasks) using commander or yargs. Support interactive and non-interactive modes.
acceptance_criteria: Can create task from command line
Can update task from command line
Can list tasks from command line
Supports both flags and interactive prompts

tasks.title: Implement Error Recovery and Transaction Safety
tasks.description: Add transaction-like behavior for multi-step operations. Implement rollback capability for failed batch operations. Add detailed error reporting with suggested remediation.
outputs: Enhanced error messages with remediation steps
acceptance_criteria: Batch operations can rollback on failure
Partial failures are tracked and reported
System can recover from transient failures

tasks.title: Create Integration Tests
tasks.description: Write integration tests that interact with real Notion API using test database. Automate setup and teardown of test data. Document test database configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests use real Notion API
